controls.name: (P1) reconstructed chain: all joins pass and every reconstructed end box meets the frozen end box of the same step
(P2) known: the intersected lookup is non-empty and lies inside each separate lookup on a request inside both chains
(P4) negatives: a reconstructed record with a shifted origin fails the join check; an end box shifted off the frozen one is detected as non-meeting (unjustified intersection refused)
(P3) replay consistency: whole-step dl/dt on frozen steps 360-370 (through the intersected lookup) is proved negative, as certified in the turning-point campaign
(P5) negative: receiver sub-intervals with a wrong origin (two steps late) refuse

(P6) KNOWN positive control of the sub-interval route: receiver cubic with acceleration 1 and jerk 2000 and an uncertain origin (1e-3), stationary partners (exact roots t - r_c(q(t), 0)); on all 4 sub-intervals the exact q and w ranges and the exact root range of each class lie inside the route's boxes; sub-intervals cover the uncertain step without a gap; the hull of the q boxes contains the exact whole-step range and lies inside the whole-step box
(P7) negative: the rate remainder dropped (stored rate bound set to 0) misses the known path on some sub-interval (or refuses)
(P8) negative: the origin uncertainty dropped (origin told as the point T0 while the true origin is T0 + 1e-3) misses the known path or roots (or refuses)
(P9) negative: an initial source bracket shifted off the true root (by 0.1, beyond the 0.03 search widening) is refused by the residual-sign containment check
controls.outcome: start interval not proved to contain the root

controls.name: (V0) outward decimal reading: the floor/ceiling box of each known decimal contains it exactly (rational check); NEGATIVE: the nearest-rounded point box of 0.1 does not contain 0.1, and the rational check detects it

(V1) KNOWN positive of the end-instant cover and root path: stationary partners (exact roots t - r_c(q, 0)), end time [5.0, 5.001], end box q [0.30, 0.50] x w [0.20, 0.26], known law q + 2w with exact image [0.7, 1.02]; the route's hull contains the exact image and exceeds it by < 1e-25 at each end; on all 9 pieces the exact root range of every class lies inside the piece's contracted source range; the pieces reach the decimal box edges

(V2) NEGATIVE dropped edge: a cover missing a top strip (width/1000) of the box is detected and the end evaluation refused; with the check bypassed the same cover misses the known exact image (the check has teeth)
controls.outcome: cover of the q end box refused: last edge is not up(x)

controls.name: (V3) NEGATIVE interior strip: a cover with a gap between pieces 0 and 1 is detected and refused
controls.outcome: cover of the q end box refused: gap between pieces 0 and 1

controls.name: (V4) NEGATIVE union larger than the box: a piece extending beyond up(x) is refused (the check enforces union == box, not only union >= box)
controls.outcome: cover of the q end box refused: piece 1 outside the box
